windows.title: Restricted time windows
windows.impact: Inside a window this account sees nothing, or only items up to the window's rating ceiling (the lower of it and the account's own ceiling). Item rules that allow an item do not reach past a window. Changes apply to the next request and are written to the audit log.
windows.daysNote: A window that ends at or before its start crosses midnight and belongs to the day it opens: Friday 22:00 to 06:00 ends on Saturday morning.
windows.endHint: HH:MM; 24:00 is midnight at the end of the day.
windows.timeZoneHint: IANA name such as Asia/Taipei or Europe/Berlin.
windows.ceilingHint: The lower of this and the account's own ceiling applies inside the window.
windows.badStart: Enter a time as HH:MM, 00:00 to 23:59.
windows.badEnd: Enter a time as HH:MM, 00:00 to 24:00.
windows.sameTimes: The end must differ from the start.
windows.badZone: Enter an IANA time zone name (not Local, at most 64 bytes).
windows.saveNote: All windows are saved together; saving an empty list removes them.

ratings.editIntro: Each code maps a rating found in item metadata to a minimum age. Codes are stored trimmed and in capitals. Write them without a "Rated " or country prefix such as "US:"; those are removed from the metadata before matching. At most {max} codes.
ratings.impact: The whole table is replaced. Every account's rating ceiling is judged with it from the next request, and the change is written to the audit log.
ratings.emptyWarning: Without codes, every item counts as unrated except bare ages such as 16+.
ratings.codePrefix: Leave out the "Rated " or country prefix.
ratings.codeDuplicate: This code is already in the table.
